annotations.title: Issue a REST API key for my worker

description: Mint a `tng_` bearer key so a worker can call Tango's HTTP worker API (pull_task, update_task, complete_task) outside MCP. The raw key is returned exactly once — hand it to the process that runs the worker and do not repeat it in chat. Requires that you own or administer the worker. Returns key_id and key_prefix; use revoke_worker_api_key with either to revoke it.

label.description: Optional note about where this key will run.

worker_id.description: The worker to mint a key for. Must be yours.

name: issue_worker_key
